correctness.rationale: For an odd-parity signed cycle, the antiperiodic signed adjacency has top eigenvalue 2cos(pi/n), of multiplicity two. The PSD trace bound is attained by a planar Gram matrix, and n>=3 unit-diagonal constraints force unique edge coordinates. For arbitrary weights w, separating m=min|w_i| from residual coefficients bounds the support gap by m(n cos(pi/n)-n+2), with equality only at constant magnitudes; the nearest cut point is ((n-2)/n)xi. One-vertex unions of cactus blocks give exact Cartesian products, whose squared Euclidean distances add. Independent eigenvalue and barycenter checks passed n=3..11; these diagnostics alone do not prove all n.
